# couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoint (Resource)

Manages an outbound private endpoint: an endpoint in a Capella cluster's network that connects to a private link service the customer owns, such as a Cloud Native Gateway in front of a self-managed cluster. Use its `hostname` as the target of an XDCR replication. Create returns once the connection request reaches the service. The customer then accepts it in their own cloud, and `status` moves from `pendingAcceptance` to `linked`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoint" "new_outbound_private_endpoint" {
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
  project_id      = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id      = "<cluster_id>"
  name            = "cng-prod"
  service_name    = "com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0123456789abcdef0"
  hostname        = "cng.acme.example.com"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_outbound_private_endpoint.new_outbound_private_endpoint \
id=3f2e1d0c-9b8a-4765-8432-10fedcba9876,cluster_id=ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000,project_id=ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000,organization_id=ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000
```
